(() => {

    return;
  }

  // config
  const disableConfig = {
    console: true,
    benefit: true,
    cheatMenu: true,
    autoplay: true
  };

  const blockedKeys = new Set();
  if (disableConfig.console) {
    blockedKeys.add("$");
  }
  if (disableConfig.benefit) {
    blockedKeys.add("~");
    blockedKeys.add("`");
  }
  if (disableConfig.cheatMenu) {
    blockedKeys.add("#");
  }
  if (disableConfig.autoplay) {
    blockedKeys.add("@");
    blockedKeys.add("$");
  }

  const keyBlocker = (e) => {
    if (blockedKeys.has(e.key)) {
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      e.preventDefault();
    }
  };

  window.addEventListener("keydown", keyBlocker, true);
  window.addEventListener("keypress", keyBlocker, true);

  const dummyStorage = {};

  const neutralizeGlobal = (propName, actualName) => {
    const dummyFunc = () => {
      console.warn(`One does not simply use ${actualName} in this scenario.`);
    };

    const desc = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window, propName);

    if (desc && !desc.configurable) {
      if (desc.writable || desc.set) {
        try {
          window[propName] = dummyFunc;
        } catch (e) {
          try {
            desc.set.call(window, dummyFunc);
          } catch (err) {}
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    try {
      Object.defineProperty(window, propName, {
        get() {
          return dummyFunc;
        },
        set(val) {
          dummyStorage[propName] = val;
        },
        configurable: true
      });
    } catch (e) {}
  };

  if (disableConfig.console) {
    neutralizeGlobal("useConsoleCheats", "Console Cheats");
    neutralizeGlobal("toggleCampaignTerminal", "Console Cheats");

    const descUCC = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window, "UsingConsoleCheats");
    if (descUCC && !descUCC.configurable) {
      if (descUCC.writable || descUCC.set) {
        window.UsingConsoleCheats = true;
      }
    } else {

        Object.defineProperty(window, "UsingConsoleCheats", {
          get() { return true; },
          set() {},
          configurable: true
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  if (disableConfig.benefit) {
    neutralizeGlobal("activateBenefitCheck", "the Benefit Checker");
    neutralizeGlobal("benefitChecker", "the Benefit Checker");
    neutralizeGlobal("benefitCheck", "the Benefit Checker");
    neutralizeGlobal("showBenefitChecker", "the Benefit Checker");
  }

  if (disableConfig.cheatMenu) {
    neutralizeGlobal("activateCheatMenu", "the Cheat Menu");
  }

  if (disableConfig.autoplay) {
    neutralizeGlobal("autoplay", "Autoplay");
    neutralizeGlobal("startAutoplayWhenReady", "Autoplay");
    neutralizeGlobal("stopAutoplay", "Autoplay");
    neutralizeGlobal("enableAutoplayUI", "Autoplay");
  }

  const purgeSelector = (selector) => {
    try {
      document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(el => el.remove());

  };

  if (disableConfig.console) {
    purgeSelector(".terminal-container");

  if (disableConfig.benefit) {

// achievement function
const ACHBOX = (() => {
    const STACK_TOP    = 12;
    const STACK_GAP    = 10;
    const DISPLAY_TIME = 5000;
    const active = [];

    function reflow() {
        const totalWidth = active.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.width, 0)
                         + STACK_GAP * (active.length - 1);

        let x = (window.innerWidth - totalWidth) / 2;
        for (const item of active) {
            item.el.style.left = x + "px";
            x += item.width + STACK_GAP;
        }
    }

    function remove(popup) {
        popup.classList.remove("is-visible");
        popup.classList.add("is-hiding");

        setTimeout(() => {
            popup.remove();
            const idx = active.findIndex(i => i.el === popup);
            if (idx !== -1) active.splice(idx, 1);
            reflow();
        }, 250);
    }

    function push(popup) {
        document.body.appendChild(popup);

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            const width = popup.offsetWidth;
            active.push({ el: popup, width });
            reflow();

            requestAnimationFrame(() => popup.classList.add("is-visible"));

            setTimeout(() => remove(popup), DISPLAY_TIME);
        });
    }

    return { push };
})();

function ensureAchievementStyles() {
    if (document.getElementById("cts-achievement-styles")) return;
    const style = document.createElement("style");
    style.id = "cts-achievement-styles";
    style.textContent = CTS_ACHIEVEMENT_CSS;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
}


function ctsAchievement(achievementName, difficultyChecker = true) {
    const temp = campaignTrail_temp;

    if (!temp?.CTS) return console.log("BLOCKED: no CTS");
    if (difficultyChecker && temp.difficulty_level_multiplier > 0.97) return console.log("BLOCKED: difficulty");
    if (temp?.cheatsActive || campaignTrail_temp?.cheatsActive) return console.log("BLOCKED: cheats");

    window.ctsUnlockedAchievements = window.ctsUnlockedAchievements || new Set();
    if (window.ctsUnlockedAchievements.has(achievementName)) return console.log("BLOCKED: already in session set");

    console.log("PASSED ALL GATES:", achievementName);
    window.ctsUnlockedAchievements.add(achievementName);

    ensureAchievementStyles();

    if (typeof window.unlockAchievement === "function") {
        const origAppendChild = document.body.appendChild;
        const origAppend = document.body.append;
        const origAlert = window.alert;

        // stub methods to suppress default popups
        document.body.appendChild = () => {};
        if (document.body.append) document.body.append = () => {};
        window.alert = () => {};

        try {
            window.unlockAchievement(achievementName);
        } catch (error) {
            console.error("Error unlocking achievement:", error);
        } finally {
            document.body.appendChild = origAppendChild;
            if (origAppend) document.body.append = origAppend;
            window.alert = origAlert;
        }
    }

    // extract achievement metadata
    const data   = temp.achievements?.[achievementName] || {};
    const title  = data.title       || achievementName;
    const desc   = data.description || "";
    const imgSrc = data.image || data.imageUrl || "https://file.garden/aaGBA-NNayasLE8D/comeback%20(1).jpg";

    // build the custom popup
    const popup = document.createElement("div");
    popup.className = "cts-achievement";
    popup.innerHTML = `
        <img class="cts-achievement__image" src="${imgSrc}" alt="">
        <div class="cts-achievement__title">${title}</div>
        ${desc ? `<div class="cts-achievement__desc">${desc}</div>` : ""}
    `;

    ACHBOX.push(popup);
}

function onGameWindowChangeCandidates() {
  const resultsTableHolder = document.getElementById("overall_details_container");

  if (!resultsTableHolder || resultsTableHolder.classList.contains("done")) {
    return;
  }

  resultsTableHolder.classList.add("done");

  const resultsTable = resultsTableHolder.childNodes[3].childNodes[3].children[0];

  for (let i = 0; i < resultsTable.children.length; i++) {
    const row = resultsTable.children[i];
    let name = row.firstChild.innerText;
    row.insertCell(1);
    if (name) {
      name = name.replaceAll("-", "").trim();
      console.log("name is:" + name)
    }

    if (i == 0) {
      row.children[1].innerHTML = `<span style="font-weight:bold">Running Mate<span>`;
    }
    else {
      row.children[1].innerHTML = vpTable[name];
    }
  }


  const resultsTableHistorical = resultsTableHolder.childNodes[5].childNodes[3].children[0];

  for (let i = 0; i < resultsTableHistorical.children.length; i++) {
    const row = resultsTableHistorical.children[i];
    let name = row.childNodes[1].innerText;
    row.insertCell(1);
    if (name) {
      name = name.replaceAll("-", "").trim();
    }

    if (i == 0) {
      row.children[1].innerHTML = `<span style="font-weight:bold">Running Mate<span>`;
    }
    else {
      row.children[1].innerHTML = vpTableHistorical[name];
    }
  }


  // Add CSS to increase row spacing
  const styleElem = document.createElement('style');
  styleElem.textContent = `
        #overall_details_container table tr {
            line-height: 1.125; /* Adjust line height as needed */
        }
    `;
  document.head.appendChild(styleElem);
}

function escapeRegExp(str) {
    return str.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
}

const compiledTooltips = tooltipList.map((tooltip, index) => ({
    index,
    regex: new RegExp(
        `(?<=\\b|\\s|^|")${escapeRegExp(tooltip.searchString)}(?=[.,;!?]?\\b|\\s|"|$)`,
        'g'
    ),
}));

function getTooltips(str) {
    const matches = [];

    for (const { index, regex } of compiledTooltips) {
        regex.lastIndex = 0;
        let match;
        while ((match = regex.exec(str)) !== null) {
            matches.push({ start: match.index, end: match.index + match[0].length, tooltipIndex: index });
        }
    }

    matches.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start || (b.end - b.start) - (a.end - a.start));

    for (let i = 0; i < matches.length - 1;) {
        if (matches[i + 1].start < matches[i].end) matches.splice(i + 1, 1);
        else i++;
    }

    return matches;
}

function applyTooltips(str) {
  const matches = getTooltips(str);
  let result = '';
  let lastIndex = 0;

  matches.forEach(match => {
    const tooltip = tooltipList[match.tooltipIndex];
    result += str.slice(lastIndex, match.start);
    result += `<span class='mytooltip'>${tooltip.searchString}<span class='mytooltiptext'>${tooltip.explanationText}</span></span>`;
    lastIndex = match.end;
  });

  result += str.slice(lastIndex); // Add the remainder of the original string
  return result;
}

function applyTooltipsToObject(obj) {
  for (let key in obj) {
    if (typeof obj[key] === 'string') {
      obj[key] = applyTooltips(obj[key]);
    } else if (typeof obj[key] === 'object') {
      applyTooltipsToObject(obj[key]); // Recursive call
    }
  }
}

applyTooltipsToObject(campaignTrail_temp.questions_json);
applyTooltipsToObject(campaignTrail_temp.answers_json);
applyTooltipsToObject(campaignTrail_temp.answer_feedback_json);

campaignTrail_temp.cyoa = true

//exchange two existing answers, default also their effects
function answerSwapper(pk1, pk2, takeEffects = true, considerTooltips = true) {
  // Hardcoded JSON data for answers
  const answerData = campaignTrail_temp.answers_json;

  // Find the indices of the objects with the specified PKs
  const index1 = answerData.findIndex(item => item.pk === pk1);
  const index2 = answerData.findIndex(item => item.pk === pk2);

  // Check if objects with those PKs exist
  if (index1 === -1 || index2 === -1) {
    return;
  }

  // Swap the descriptions and original descriptions if they exist
  let description1 = answerData[index1].fields.originalDescription || answerData[index1].fields.description;
  let description2 = answerData[index2].fields.originalDescription || answerData[index2].fields.description;

  // If originalDescription exists, swap those too
  if (answerData[index1].fields.originalDescription || answerData[index2].fields.originalDescription) {
    answerData[index1].fields.originalDescription = description2;
    answerData[index2].fields.originalDescription = description1;
  }

  // Swap the current descriptions
  answerData[index1].fields.description = description2;
  answerData[index2].fields.description = description1;

  // Always swap the answer fields in the answer_feedback_json
  campaignTrail_temp.answer_feedback_json.forEach(item => {
    if (item.fields.answer === pk1) {
      item.fields.answer = pk2;
    } else if (item.fields.answer === pk2) {
      item.fields.answer = pk1;
    }
  });

  // If takeEffects is true, answers swap effects also
  if (takeEffects) {
    const otherJsons = [
      campaignTrail_temp.answer_score_global_json,
      campaignTrail_temp.answer_score_issue_json,
      campaignTrail_temp.answer_score_state_json
    ];

    otherJsons.forEach(jsonData => {
      jsonData.forEach(item => {
        if (item.fields.answer === pk1) {
          item.fields.answer = pk2;
        } else if (item.fields.answer === pk2) {
          item.fields.answer = pk1;
        }
      });
    });
  }
}



function applyDrift(candidateId, driftAmount, stateId) {
  // Loop through each object in the JSON array
  campaignTrail_temp.candidate_state_multiplier_json.forEach((item) => {
    // Check if the candidate ID matches the given candidate
    if (item.fields.candidate === candidateId) {
      // If stateId is undefined or empty, apply drift to all states for that candidate
      if (stateId === undefined || stateId.length === 0) {
        item.fields.state_multiplier += driftAmount;
        item.fields.state_multiplier = Math.max(0, item.fields.state_multiplier); // Ensure the multiplier never goes below 0
      } else {
        // If stateId is an array, loop through it
        if (Array.isArray(stateId)) {
          if (stateId.includes(item.fields.state)) {
            item.fields.state_multiplier += driftAmount;
            item.fields.state_multiplier = Math.max(0, item.fields.state_multiplier); // Ensure the multiplier never goes below 0
          }
        } else {
          // If stateId is a single value, just check it
          if (item.fields.state === stateId) {
            item.fields.state_multiplier += driftAmount;
            item.fields.state_multiplier = Math.max(0, item.fields.state_multiplier); // Ensure the multiplier never goes below 0
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

function applyMultiplier(candidateId, multiplier, StateId) { //while Nina's drift logic is useful, it isn't a precise multiplier - it has more of an impact where the state multiplier is smaller and vice versa when larger.
  if (StateId === undefined || StateId.length === 0) { //applies everywhere
    for (let StateNum = 456; StateNum < 506; StateNum++) {
      current_multiplier = e.candidate_state_multiplier_json.find(p => p.fields.state == StateNum && p.fields.candidate == candidateId).fields.state_multiplier
      applyDrift(candidateId, current_multiplier * multiplier, StateNum) //apply that multiplier in that state.
    }
  }
  else {
    current_multiplier = e.candidate_state_multiplier_json.find(p => p.fields.state == StateId && p.fields.candidate == candidateId).fields.state_multiplier
    applyDrift(candidateId, current_multiplier * multiplier, StateId) //apply that multiplier in that state.
  }

}

function applyInflation(InflationAmount) {
  cumulative_inflation += InflationAmount / 12.0;
}

function logDeltas(qNum, currentVars) {
  console.log(`%c=== Question #${qNum} report ===`, "color: #3498db; font-weight: bold;");

  for (const [varName, currentValue] of Object.entries(currentVars)) {
    // if it's the first time tracking, compare against starting value or 0
    const prevValue = prevVars[varName] !== undefined ? prevVars[varName] : 0;
    const delta = currentValue - prevValue;
    const deltaSign = delta > 0 ? `+${delta}` : `${delta}`;

    console.log(`${varName}: ${currentValue} (Change: ${deltaSign})`);

    // save the new value as the "previous" value for next turn
    prevVars[varName] = currentValue;
  }
}

  ans = campaignTrail_temp.player_answers[campaignTrail_temp.player_answers.length - 1];

  LegislativeAchievements = Legislate + EconomyandConsumerGoods;
  MoodForWar = WarSupport - AntiWar

  OtherDealsLeverage = ((((MoodForWar - (BlackArts) + TroopMoraleSurge + LegislativeAchievements + HiddenLeverageNormalization + TheTreatment)))/1.05); // For determining the other deals not related to the mainline deal.

  // Thanks StrawberryMaster for Womble!

 // This function changes the turnout for a given state or all states
  // by applying a multiplier to the popular votes.
  // originally shown in Things That Never Were
  const changeTurnout = (multiplier = 1.0, stateSelector = 0) => {
    if (stateSelector !== 0) {
      // check for state PK or abbrev
      const targetState = e.states_json.find(f =>
        f.pk === stateSelector || f.fields.abbr === stateSelector
      );

      if (targetState) {
        // apply multiplier
        targetState.fields.popular_votes = Math.floor(targetState.fields.popular_votes * multiplier);
      } else {
        console.warn(`State '${stateSelector}' could not be found.`);
      }
    } else {
      // otherwise, just target every state
      e.states_json.forEach(state => {
        state.fields.popular_votes = Math.floor(state.fields.popular_votes * multiplier);
      });
    }
  }

  // This function replaces the advisor image for specific answers,
// sometimes based on additional game state conditions.
(function() {
    'use strict';

    const QUESTION_CASES = {
        40582: {
            hideImage: true,
            condition: () => true
        },
        40625: {
            hideImage: true,
            condition: () => true
        },
        40627: {
            hideImage: true,
            condition: () => true
        },
        40639: {

            condition: () => true
        },
        40648: {

            condition: () => true
        },
         40649: {
            hideImage: true,
            condition: () => true
        },
         40660: {
            hideImage: true,
            condition: () => true
        },
          40768: {
            hideImage: true,
            condition: () => true
        }       
    };

    const FEEDBACK_IMAGE_SELECTOR = "#visit_content img";

    function handleAdvisorUpdate() {
        const feedbackImage = document.querySelector(FEEDBACK_IMAGE_SELECTOR);
        if (!feedbackImage) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            const temp = window.campaignTrail_temp;
            if (!temp || !Array.isArray(temp.player_answers) || !Array.isArray(temp.questions_json)) {
                return;
            }

            const answers = temp.player_answers;
            if (answers.length === 0) {
                return;
            }

            const lastAnswerIndex = answers.length - 1;
            const currentQuestion = temp.questions_json[lastAnswerIndex];

            if (!currentQuestion) {
                return;
            }

            const currentQuestionId = currentQuestion.pk;
            const specialCase = QUESTION_CASES[currentQuestionId];

            if (specialCase && (typeof specialCase.condition !== 'function' || specialCase.condition())) {
                if (specialCase.hideImage) {
                    // hide the image element
                    feedbackImage.style.display = "none";
                } else if (specialCase.imageUrl) {
                    feedbackImage.style.display = ""; 
                    if (feedbackImage.src !== specialCase.imageUrl) {
                        feedbackImage.src = specialCase.imageUrl;
                    }
                }
            } else {
                // ensure the image is visible again for standard questions
                feedbackImage.style.display = "";
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error("Error during advisor image update:", error);
        }
    }

    // wrap the engine's global answerEffects function
    if (typeof window.answerEffects === "function") {
        const originalAnswerEffects = window.answerEffects;
        
        window.answerEffects = function() {
            originalAnswerEffects.apply(this, arguments);
            handleAdvisorUpdate();
        };
    } else {
        console.warn("answerEffects was not found.");
    }

})();

  // This lets you remove candidates more easily. Taken from 2012 - Obamanation
  (function () {
    const e = campaignTrail_temp;

    function ensureNumber(x, def = 0) {
      const n = Number(x);
      return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : def;
    }

    function unique(arr) {
      return Array.from(new Set(arr));
    }

    function getStateMeta(statePk) {
      return e.states_json.find((s) => s.pk === Number(statePk))?.fields || null;
    }

    // d'Hondt for primary mode if needed
    function dhondtAlloc(votes, seats, thresh = 0.15) {
      const totals = votes.slice();
      const allocations = new Array(totals.length).fill(0);
      const sum = totals.reduce((a, b) => a + ensureNumber(b, 0), 0);
      const perc = totals.map((v) => (sum > 0 ? v / sum : 0));
      for (let i = 0; i < seats; i++) {
        let bestIdx = -1;
        let bestQ = -1;
        for (let c = 0; c < totals.length; c++) {
          const q = perc[c] < thresh ? 0 : totals[c] / (allocations[c] + 1);
          if (q > bestQ) { bestQ = q; bestIdx = c; }
        }
        if (bestIdx >= 0) allocations[bestIdx] += 1;
      }
      return allocations;
    }

    function recomputeEVsForState(stateEntry) {
      const stFields = getStateMeta(stateEntry.state);
      if (!stFields) return;

      const totalEV = ensureNumber(stFields.electoral_votes, 0);
      if (totalEV <= 0) {
        stateEntry.result.forEach((cr) => (cr.electoral_votes = 0));
        return;
      }

      // keep sorted desc by percent for EV assignment
      stateEntry.result.sort((a, b) => b.percent - a.percent);

      if (e.primary) {
        const votes = stateEntry.result.map((r) => ensureNumber(r.votes, 0));
        const alloc = dhondtAlloc(votes, totalEV, 0.15);
        stateEntry.result.forEach((r, i) => (r.electoral_votes = alloc[i] || 0));
        return;
      }

      const isProp = Number(e.game_type_id) === 2;
      if (isProp) {
        const shares = divideElectoralVotesProp(stateEntry.result.map((r) => r.percent), totalEV);
        stateEntry.result.forEach((r, i) => (r.electoral_votes = shares[i] || 0));
        return;
      }

      if (ensureNumber(stFields.winner_take_all_flg, 0) === 1) {
        stateEntry.result.forEach((r, i) => (r.electoral_votes = i === 0 ? totalEV : 0));
      } else {
        const totVotes = stateEntry.result.reduce((acc, r) => acc + ensureNumber(r.votes, 0), 0);
        const topVotes = ensureNumber(stateEntry.result[0]?.votes, 0);
        const [L, D] = splitEVTopTwo(totalEV, topVotes, totVotes);
        stateEntry.result.forEach((r, i) => (r.electoral_votes = i === 0 ? L : i === 1 ? D : 0));
      }
    }

    function buildSyntheticVotesIfNeeded(stateEntry) {
      const hasVotes = stateEntry.result.some((r) => ensureNumber(r.votes, 0) > 0);
      if (hasVotes) return;
      const totalPct = stateEntry.result.reduce((acc, r) => acc + ensureNumber(r.percent, 0), 0);
      if (totalPct <= 0) return;
      const st = getStateMeta(stateEntry.state);
      const totalVotes = Math.max(1, ensureNumber(st?.popular_votes, 0)) || 1000000;
      for (const r of stateEntry.result) {
        r.votes = Math.floor(ensureNumber(r.percent, 0) * totalVotes);
      }
    }

    function finalizeStateResult(stateEntry) {
      buildSyntheticVotesIfNeeded(stateEntry);
      const totalVotes = stateEntry.result.reduce((acc, r) => acc + ensureNumber(r.votes, 0), 0);
      for (const r of stateEntry.result) {
        r.percent = totalVotes > 0 ? ensureNumber(r.votes, 0) / totalVotes : 0;
      }
      recomputeEVsForState(stateEntry);
      stateEntry.result.sort((a, b) => b.percent - a.percent);
    }

    function computeRemovedVotes(stateEntry, removed) {
      const removedVotes = ensureNumber(removed.votes, 0);
      if (removedVotes > 0) return removedVotes;

      const removedPct = ensureNumber(removed.percent, 0);
      if (removedPct <= 0) return 0;

      buildSyntheticVotesIfNeeded(stateEntry);
      const baseTotal = stateEntry.result
        .filter((r) => r.candidate !== removed.candidate)
        .reduce((acc, r) => acc + ensureNumber(r.votes, 0), 0);

      if (baseTotal <= 0) return Math.round(removedPct * 1000000);
      return (removedPct / Math.max(1e-12, 1 - removedPct)) * baseTotal;
    }

    function proportionalize(stateEntry, extraVotes) {
      const baseTotal = stateEntry.result.reduce((acc, r) => acc + ensureNumber(r.votes, 0), 0);
      if (baseTotal <= 0) return;
      for (const r of stateEntry.result) {
        const share = ensureNumber(r.votes, 0) / baseTotal;
        r.votes = ensureNumber(r.votes, 0) + share * extraVotes;
      }
    }

    function ensureCandidateInState(stateEntry, candPk) {
      const present = stateEntry.result.some((r) => Number(r.candidate) === Number(candPk));
      if (present) return;
      stateEntry.result.push({
        candidate: Number(candPk),
        result: 0,
        electoral_votes: 0,
        percent: 0,
        votes: 0,
      });
    }

    function redistributeStateResult(stateEntry, removedPk, mode, opts) {
      const target = Number(opts?.target);
      const weightsObj = opts?.weights || null;
      const insertTargetIfMissing = opts?.insertTargetIfMissing !== false;

      const idx = stateEntry.result.findIndex((r) => Number(r.candidate) === Number(removedPk));
      if (idx === -1) return;

      const removed = stateEntry.result[idx];
      const extraVotes = computeRemovedVotes(stateEntry, removed);

      stateEntry.result.splice(idx, 1);

      if (stateEntry.result.length === 0) {
        finalizeStateResult(stateEntry);
        return;
      }

      if (extraVotes > 0) {
        if (mode === 'toCandidate' && Number.isFinite(target)) {
          if (insertTargetIfMissing) ensureCandidateInState(stateEntry, target);
          const tgt = stateEntry.result.find((r) => Number(r.candidate) === target);
          if (tgt) {
            tgt.votes = ensureNumber(tgt.votes, 0) + extraVotes;
          } else {
            proportionalize(stateEntry, extraVotes);
          }
        } else if (mode === 'weights' && weightsObj && typeof weightsObj === 'object') {
          const presentIds = stateEntry.result.map((r) => Number(r.candidate));
          const weights = presentIds.map((pk) => Math.max(0, ensureNumber(weightsObj[pk], 0)));
          const sumW = weights.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
          if (sumW > 0) {
            for (let i = 0; i < stateEntry.result.length; i++) {
              const add = (weights[i] / sumW) * extraVotes;
              stateEntry.result[i].votes = ensureNumber(stateEntry.result[i].votes, 0) + add;
            }
          } else {
            proportionalize(stateEntry, extraVotes);
          }
        } else {
          proportionalize(stateEntry, extraVotes);
        }
      }

      finalizeStateResult(stateEntry);
    }

    function applyRedistributionToArray(stateArray, removedPk, mode, opts) {
      if (!Array.isArray(stateArray)) return;
      for (const st of stateArray) {
        if (!st || !Array.isArray(st.result)) continue;
        redistributeStateResult(st, removedPk, mode, opts);
      }
    }

    function rebuildFinalOverallFromStates() {
      const candIds = unique(
        (e.final_state_results || [])
          .flatMap((st) => (Array.isArray(st.result) ? st.result : []))
          .map((r) => Number(r.candidate))
          .filter((pk) => Number.isFinite(pk))
      );

      e.final_overall_results = candIds.map((pk) => ({
        candidate: pk,
        electoral_votes: 0,
        popular_votes: 0,
      }));

      handleFinalResults(500);
    }

    // A() wrapper for future polls/results
    function patchAOnce() {
      if (window.__ctApatched) return;
      const origA = window.A;
      if (typeof origA !== 'function') return;

      window.__ct_dropouts ||= [];
      window.A = function patchedA(t) {
        const res = origA.call(this, t);
        const arr = Array.isArray(res) ? res : (Array.isArray(res?.[1]) ? res[1] : null);
        if (!Array.isArray(arr) || !window.__ct_dropouts?.length) return res;

        for (const rule of window.__ct_dropouts) {
          applyRedistributionToArray(arr, rule.removedPk, rule.mode, {
            target: rule.target,
            weights: rule.weights,
            insertTargetIfMissing: true,
          });
        }
        return res;
      };
      window.__ctApatched = true;
    }

    // storage for backups to allow restore
    window.__ct_dropout_backups ||= {}; // { [pk]: { removedCSMRows: [], wasActive: 0|1, wasInOpponents: boolean } }

    window.clearDropouts = function clearDropouts() {
      window.__ct_dropouts = [];
    };

    window.listDropouts = function listDropouts() {
      return (window.__ct_dropouts || []).slice();
    };

    window.removeDropoutRule = function removeDropoutRule(pk) {
      if (!window.__ct_dropouts) return;
      window.__ct_dropouts = window.__ct_dropouts.filter((r) => Number(r.removedPk) !== Number(pk));
    };

    function deepClone(obj) {
      try { return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obj)); } catch { return obj; }
    }

    // the API.
    window.removeCandidate = function removeCandidate(removedPk, options = {}) {
      const {
        mode = 'proportional', // 'proportional' | 'toCandidate' | 'weights'
        target,
        weights,
        touch = 'polls', // 'polls' | 'final' | 'both' | 'none'
        removeFromOpponentList = true,
        deactivateInRoster = true,
        insertTargetIfMissing = true,
      } = options;

      if (Number(removedPk) === Number(e.candidate_id)) {
        console.warn('removeCandidate: refusing to remove the player candidate.');
        return;
      }

      // init backups container for this pk
      const bk = (window.__ct_dropout_backups[removedPk] ||= { removedCSMRows: [], wasActive: null, wasInOpponents: null });

      // hide from roster and opponent list
      if (removeFromOpponentList && Array.isArray(e.opponents_list)) {
        bk.wasInOpponents ??= e.opponents_list.includes(Number(removedPk));
        e.opponents_list = e.opponents_list.filter((pk) => Number(pk) !== Number(removedPk));
      }

      if (deactivateInRoster && Array.isArray(e.candidate_json)) {
        const c = e.candidate_json.find((c) => Number(c.pk) === Number(removedPk));
        if (c && c.fields) {
          if (bk.wasActive == null) bk.wasActive = c.fields.is_active;
          c.fields.is_active = 0;
        }
      }

      // for pure proportional dropout we delete multipliers; for transfer modes we keep them
      if (mode === 'proportional') {
        const arr = (e.candidate_state_multiplier_json || []);
        const kept = [];
        const removedRows = [];
        for (const row of arr) {
          if (Number(row?.fields?.candidate) === Number(removedPk)) {
            removedRows.push(deepClone(row));
          } else {
            kept.push(row);
          }
        }
        bk.removedCSMRows = removedRows;
        e.candidate_state_multiplier_json = kept;
      }

      // register/patch for future polls and results
      patchAOnce();
      window.__ct_dropouts ||= [];
      window.__ct_dropouts = window.__ct_dropouts.filter((r) => Number(r.removedPk) !== Number(removedPk));
      window.__ct_dropouts.push({ removedPk: Number(removedPk), mode, target: Number(target), weights });

      // rewrite any cached arrays now if requested
      if (touch === 'polls' || touch === 'both') {
        let pollStates = null;
        if (Array.isArray(e.current_results)) {
          const maybeStates = e.current_results[1];
          if (Array.isArray(maybeStates) && maybeStates[0]?.result) {
            pollStates = maybeStates;
          }
        }
        if (Array.isArray(pollStates)) {
          applyRedistributionToArray(pollStates, removedPk, mode, { target, weights, insertTargetIfMissing });
        }
      }

      if ((touch === 'final' || touch === 'both') && Array.isArray(e.final_state_results)) {
        applyRedistributionToArray(e.final_state_results, removedPk, mode, { target, weights, insertTargetIfMissing });
        rebuildFinalOverallFromStates();
      }

      console.info(
        `removeCandidate(${removedPk}) done. Mode: ${mode}${mode === 'toCandidate' ? ` -> ${target}` : mode === 'weights' ? ' (weights)' : ''
        }. Touch: ${touch}.`
      );
    };

    window.restoreCandidate = function restoreCandidate(pk, options = {}) {
      const {
        touch = 'polls', // 'polls' | 'final' | 'both' | 'none'
        addToOpponentList = true, // re-add to opponents_list if missing
        reactivateInRoster = true, // set is_active back to 1 (or previous value if backed up)
        preferBackupMultipliers = true, // if we deleted multipliers before, restore from backup
      } = options;

      if (Number(pk) === Number(e.candidate_id)) {
        console.warn('restoreCandidate: player candidate is already active.');
        return;
      }

      // remove dropout redistribution rule for this candidate
      window.removeDropoutRule?.(pk);

      // restore multipliers if we backed them up (only relevant if we did a proportional delete)
      const bk = window.__ct_dropout_backups?.[pk];
      if (preferBackupMultipliers && bk && Array.isArray(bk.removedCSMRows) && bk.removedCSMRows.length) {
        const existingKey = new Set(
          (e.candidate_state_multiplier_json || []).map(
            (row) => `${row?.fields?.candidate}|${row?.fields?.state}`
          )
        );
        for (const row of bk.removedCSMRows) {
          const key = `${row.fields.candidate}|${row.fields.state}`;
          if (!existingKey.has(key)) {
            e.candidate_state_multiplier_json.push(deepClone(row));
            existingKey.add(key);
          }
        }
        // clear backup so repeated restore doesn't duplicate
        bk.removedCSMRows = [];
      }

      // re-add to opponents_list if requested
      if (addToOpponentList && Array.isArray(e.opponents_list)) {
        if (!e.opponents_list.includes(Number(pk))) {
          e.opponents_list.push(Number(pk));
        }
      } else if (bk?.wasInOpponents && Array.isArray(e.opponents_list) && !e.opponents_list.includes(Number(pk))) {
        // if caller didn't force add, but we know it used to be there, re-add to match original state
        e.opponents_list.push(Number(pk));
      }

      // reactivate in roster if requested
      if (reactivateInRoster && Array.isArray(e.candidate_json)) {
        const c = e.candidate_json.find((c) => Number(c.pk) === Number(pk));
        if (c && c.fields) {
          const prev = bk?.wasActive;
          c.fields.is_active = (prev != null) ? prev : 1;
        }
      }

      // refresh cached arrays if requested
      if (touch === 'polls' || touch === 'both') {
        try {
          const polls = A(2);
          // update e.current_results in the same shape as the code expects
          const latest = window.getLatestRes ? window.getLatestRes(polls) : null;
          e.current_results = latest ? [latest[0], polls] : polls;
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn('restoreCandidate: failed to recompute polls:', err);
        }
      }

      if (touch === 'final' || touch === 'both') {
        try {
          e.final_state_results = A(1);
          rebuildFinalOverallFromStates();
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn('restoreCandidate: failed to recompute final via A(1):', err);
        }
      }

      console.info(`restoreCandidate(${pk}) complete. Touch: ${touch}. Rule removed; candidate reactivated.`);
    };
  })();

    function calculateCandidateElectoralVotes(finalResults) {
        // Variables to hold electoral vote counts for each candidate [you have to define these or else the game won't work.]
        let playerEV = 0;
        let DemocratEV = 0;
        let RightWingEV = 0;
        let LeftWingEV = 0;
    
  
        // Loop through each state result to sum up electoral votes by candidate (Taken from All the Way)
        finalResults.forEach(stateResult => {
            stateResult.result.forEach(candidateResult => {
                const candidateId = candidateResult.candidate; // Candidate's unique identifier
                const electoralVotes = candidateResult.electoral_votes; // Electoral votes for this candidate in this state
    
                // Assign electoral votes to the appropriate candidate's total
                switch (candidateId) {
                    case 152: // Replace 152 with Player Republican's actual candidate ID
                        playerEV += electoralVotes;
                        break;
                    case 153: // Replace 153 with Opponent's actual candidate ID
                        DemocratEV += electoralVotes;
                        break;
                    case 154: // Replace 154 with Right-Wing Libertarian actual candidate ID
                        RightWingEV += electoralVotes;
                        break;
                    case 155: // Any other candidate ID will be counted as Fourth Party
                        LeftWingEV += electoralVotes;
                        break;
                }
            });
        });
    
        // Return an object containing the results for each candidate
        return {
            playerEV,   
            DemocratEV,
            RightWingEV,
            LeftWingEV,
        };
    }

function updateQuestions() {
  const answersa = document.getElementsByClassName("game_answers");

  for (let i = 0; i < answersa.length; i++) {
    const answerab = answersa[i];
    if (answerab.classList.contains("done")) {
      continue;
    }
    answerab.classList.add("done");

    let answerObject = campaignTrail_temp.answers_json.find((x) => x.pk == answerab.value);

    if (answerObject && answerObject.fields.condition != null) {
      answerab.disabled = !(eval(answerObject.fields.condition));
    }
  }
}

function addTooltipToAnswer(pk, tooltipText, pictureUrl) {
  const ansIndex = campaignTrail_temp.answers_json.findIndex(item => item.pk === pk);
  if (ansIndex === -1) return;

  const answer = campaignTrail_temp.answers_json[ansIndex];
  if (!answer.fields.originalDescription) {
    answer.fields.originalDescription = answer.fields.description;
  }

  const tooltipHTML = `
        <span class='mytooltipa' style='background-color: #ffa0a0'>
            [X]
            <span class='bubble bubble-bottom-left'>
                <div style='display: flex; align-items: center;'>
                    <img src='${pictureUrl}' style='height: 3em;'>
                    <span style='display: inline-block; margin-left: 5px;'>${tooltipText}</span>
                </div>
            </span>
        </span>
    `;

  answer.fields.description = answer.fields.originalDescription + tooltipHTML;
  setLabelContentByPk(pk, answer.fields.description);
}

function setLabelContentByPk(pk, newContent) {
  const radioInput = document.querySelector(`input[type="radio"][value="${pk}"]`);
  if (!radioInput) return;
  const label = document.querySelector(`label[for="${radioInput.id}"]`);
  if (label) label.innerHTML = newContent;
}

let savedX = null;
let savedY = null;

function addHeadquarterAButton() {
  if (document.getElementById('headquarterA_button')) return;

  const refButton = document.getElementById('view_electoral_map');
  if (!refButton) return;

  const newButtonA = document.createElement('button');
  newButtonA.id = 'headquarterA_button';
  newButtonA.style.marginLeft = '1.5em';
  newButtonA.innerHTML = 'Your Notes';
  newButtonA.addEventListener('click', toggleHeadquarterA);
  refButton.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', newButtonA);
}

function openHeadquarterA() {
  let popOutMenu = document.getElementById('popOutMenu');
  if (popOutMenu) {
    popOutMenu.style.display = 'flex';
    popOutMenu.style.transform = 'scale(0.8)';
    popOutMenu.style.opacity = '0';
    popOutMenu.style.transition = 'opacity 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease';

    setTimeout(() => {
      popOutMenu.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
      popOutMenu.style.opacity = '1';
    }, 10);
    return;
  }
  if (!popOutMenu) {
    popOutMenu = document.createElement('div');
    popOutMenu.id = 'popOutMenu';
    popOutMenu.style.position = 'fixed';
    popOutMenu.style.left = savedX !== null ? savedX + 'px' : '328px';
    popOutMenu.style.top = savedY !== null ? savedY + 'px' : '350px';
    popOutMenu.style.width = '620px';
    popOutMenu.style.minHeight = '200px';
    popOutMenu.style.maxHeight = 'auto';
    popOutMenu.style.background = 'linear-gradient(180deg, white, #eee)';
    popOutMenu.style.border = '1px solid rgb(21, 35, 52)';
    popOutMenu.style.borderRadius = '2px';
    popOutMenu.style.boxShadow = '0 12px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
    popOutMenu.style.color = '#003153';
    popOutMenu.style.fontFamily = '"Verdana", sans-serif';
    popOutMenu.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    popOutMenu.style.userSelect = 'none';
    popOutMenu.style.display = 'flex';
    popOutMenu.style.flexDirection = 'column';
    popOutMenu.style.transform = 'scale(0.8)';
    popOutMenu.style.opacity = '0';
    popOutMenu.style.transition = 'opacity 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease';

    setTimeout(() => {
      popOutMenu.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
      popOutMenu.style.opacity = '1';
    }, 10);

    // Title bar
    const titleBar = document.createElement('div');
    titleBar.style.background = 'linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(104, 131, 158),rgb(62, 117, 173))';
    titleBar.style.padding = '12px 16px';
    titleBar.style.cursor = 'move';
    titleBar.style.display = 'flex';
    titleBar.style.justifyContent = 'space-between';
    titleBar.style.alignItems = 'center';
    titleBar.style.borderBottom = '1px solid rgb(19, 34, 48)';
    titleBar.style.boxShadow = 'inset 0 -1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';

    const menuTitle = document.createElement('h1');
    menuTitle.innerText = 'Your Notes On Political Happenings';
    menuTitle.style.margin = '0';
    menuTitle.style.fontSize = '20px';
    menuTitle.style.fontWeight = '600';
    menuTitle.style.color = '#c5d2e0';
    titleBar.appendChild(menuTitle);

    const closeButton = document.createElement('button');
    closeButton.innerText = '✕';
    closeButton.style.background = 'transparent';
    closeButton.style.border = 'none';
    closeButton.style.color = '#E00000';
    closeButton.style.fontSize = '18px';
    closeButton.style.cursor = 'pointer';
    closeButton.onmouseover = () => closeButton.style.color = '#A80000';
    closeButton.onmouseout = () => closeButton.style.color = '#E00000';
    closeButton.onclick = () => closeHeadquarterA(true);
    titleBar.appendChild(closeButton);

    popOutMenu.appendChild(titleBar);

    // Content container
    const content = document.createElement('div');
    content.id = 'headquarterA_content';
    content.style.padding = '14px 18px 16px 18px';
    content.style.display = 'flex';
    content.style.flexDirection = 'column';
    content.style.gap = '10px';
    content.style.flexGrow = '1';
    popOutMenu.appendChild(content);

    document.body.appendChild(popOutMenu);

    makeDraggable(popOutMenu, popOutMenu);

    updateHeadquarterAContent();
  }

  popOutMenu.style.display = 'flex';
}

function toggleHeadquarterA() {
  const popOutMenu = document.getElementById('popOutMenu');
  if (popOutMenu && popOutMenu.style.display !== 'none') {
    closeHeadquarterA(true);
  } else {
    openHeadquarterA();
  }
}

function closeHeadquarterA(animated = false) {
  const popOutMenu = document.getElementById('popOutMenu');
  if (!popOutMenu) return;

  savedX = popOutMenu.offsetLeft;
  savedY = popOutMenu.offsetTop;

  if (animated) {
    popOutMenu.style.transform = 'scale(0.8)';
    popOutMenu.style.opacity = '0';
    setTimeout(() => popOutMenu.style.display = 'none', 250);
  } else {
    popOutMenu.style.display = 'none';
  }
}

// draggable with full document clamping
function makeDraggable(element, handle = element) {
  let isDragging = false;
  let offsetX, offsetY;

  handle.addEventListener("mousedown", function (event) {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    isDragging = true;

    offsetX = event.pageX - element.offsetLeft;
    offsetY = event.pageY - element.offsetTop;

    document.addEventListener("mousemove", onMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener("mouseup", onMouseUp);
  });

  function onMouseMove(event) {
    if (!isDragging) return;

    let newX = event.pageX - offsetX;
    let newY = event.pageY - offsetY;

    const docWidth = document.documentElement.scrollWidth;
    const docHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;

    const overflowX = element.offsetWidth * 0.25;
    const overflowY = element.offsetHeight * 0.25;

    // clamp relative to viewport
    const maxX = window.innerWidth - element.offsetWidth + overflowX;
    const maxY = window.innerHeight - element.offsetHeight + overflowY;

    newX = Math.max(-overflowX, Math.min(newX, maxX));
    newY = Math.max(-overflowY, Math.min(newY, maxY));

    element.style.left = newX + "px";
    element.style.top = newY + "px";

    savedX = newX;
    savedY = newY;
  }

  function onMouseUp() {
    isDragging = false;
    document.removeEventListener("mousemove", onMouseMove);
    document.removeEventListener("mouseup", onMouseUp);
  }
}

function createSimplePopup() {
  const popup = document.createElement("div");
  popup.id = "simplePopup";
  popup.style.position = "fixed";
  popup.style.bottom = "20px";
  popup.style.right = "20px";
  popup.style.width = "240px";
  popup.style.height = "260px";
  popup.style.border = "1px solid #000";
  popup.style.borderRadius = "5px";
  popup.style.padding = "40px 10px 10px 10px";
  popup.style.boxShadow = "0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)";
  popup.style.zIndex = "10000";
  popup.style.fontFamily = "'Andale Mono', 'New Courier', monospace";
  popup.style.fontSize = "14px";
  popup.style.color = "#000";
  popup.style.backgroundImage = "url('https://i.imgur.com/BxEZQ9q.png')";
  popup.style.backgroundSize = "cover";
  popup.style.backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat";
  popup.style.backgroundPosition = "center";
  popup.style.display = "block";

  const content = document.createElement("div");
  content.id = "popupContent";
  content.style.pointerEvents = "auto";
  popup.appendChild(content);

  document.body.appendChild(popup);

  injectTooltipStyles(); // <-- inject styles ONCE
  makePopupDraggable(popup);
  updateSimplePopup();
}


function makePopupDraggable(popup) {
  let offsetX = 0;
  let offsetY = 0;
  let isDragging = false;

  popup.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
    isDragging = true;
    offsetX = e.clientX - popup.getBoundingClientRect().left;
    offsetY = e.clientY - popup.getBoundingClientRect().top;
    document.addEventListener("mousemove", onMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener("mouseup", onMouseUp);
  });

  function onMouseMove(e) {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    let newX = e.clientX - offsetX;
    let newY = e.clientY - offsetY;
    const maxX = window.innerWidth - popup.offsetWidth + 150;
    const maxY = window.innerHeight - popup.offsetHeight + 150;
    newX = Math.max(-50, Math.min(newX, maxX));
    newY = Math.max(-50, Math.min(newY, maxY));
    popup.style.left = `${newX}px`;
    popup.style.top = `${newY}px`;
    popup.style.bottom = "auto";
    popup.style.right = "auto";
  }

  function onMouseUp() {
    isDragging = false;
    document.removeEventListener("mousemove", onMouseMove);
    document.removeEventListener("mouseup", onMouseUp);
  }
}

function injectTooltipStyles() {
  if (document.getElementById("tooltipStyles")) return;

  const style = document.createElement("style");
  style.id = "tooltipStyles";
  style.textContent = `
        .hover-value {
            border-bottom: 1px dotted #000;
            cursor: help;
            position: relative;
        }

        .hover-value::after {
            content: attr(data-tooltip);
            position: absolute;
            background: url('https://i.imgur.com/BxEZQ9q.png') center/cover no-repeat;
            color: #000;
            padding: 6px 10px;
            font-family: 'Andale Mono', 'New Courier', monospace;
            font-size: 13px;
            border: 1px solid #000;
            border-radius: 5px;
            box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
            white-space: nowrap;
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            top: -32px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            z-index: 10001;
            transition: opacity 0.2s ease-in-out;
        }

        .hover-value:hover::after {
            opacity: 1;
        }
    `;
  document.head.appendChild(style);
}

'We do not want deflationary pressure ever. This will hurt the economy.' :
      cumulative_inflation < 5 ? 'Absolutely irrelevant. This is pretty good inflation.' :
        cumulative_inflation < 10 ? 'This is average and fine inflation. Ignore it.' :
          cumulative_inflation < 15 ? 'Inflation is something to be aware of, but, no need to worry.' :
            cumulative_inflation < 20 ? 'The masses are feeling the pinch.' :
              cumulative_inflation < 25 ? 'Slow the brakes or else the masses will get more upset.' :
                cumulative_inflation < 30 ? 'Rodney, stop this hyperinflation at once.' :
                  '1920s Weimar Republic called.'
    }">${cumulative_inflation.toFixed(2)}</span>%</strong></p>

      <p><strong>
        <span class="hover-value" data-tooltip="How much water do we have to extinguish this fire?">Outlook on the War</span>: 
        <span class="hover-value" data-tooltip="${Leverage === "Hidden." ? 'Check back later. We cannot say for now.' :
      Leverage < -1 ? 'No go, we are doomed.' :
        Leverage === -1 ? 'We are leaning on being annihilated.' :
          Leverage === 0 ? 'The tipping point of destruction.' :
            Leverage < 3 ? 'A light at the end of the tunnel.' :
              Leverage < 6 ? 'A meat ginder through and through.' :
                Leverage < 9 ? 'China will never surrender, imperialist dog.' :
                  Leverage < 11 ? 'It would not be in our best interest to end the war right now.' :
                    Leverage < 16 ? 'We want total victory. We will not stop the war...' :
                      'Peace with Honor.'
    }">${Leverage}</span>
      </strong></p>
    `;
}


function toggleSimplePopup() {
  const popup = document.getElementById("simplePopup");
  if (!popup) return;
  popup.style.display = (popup.style.display === "none") ? "block" : "none";
}

function addHeadquarterButton() {
  if (document.getElementById('headquarter_button')) return;
  const refButton = document.getElementById('view_electoral_map');
  if (!refButton) return;
  const newButton = document.createElement('button');
  newButton.id = 'headquarter_button';
  newButton.style.marginLeft = '1.5em';
  newButton.innerHTML = 'By the Numbers';
  newButton.addEventListener('click', toggleSimplePopup);
  refButton.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', newButton);
}

class ChartEnhancer {
  static sheet = new CSSStyleSheet();
  static stylesInjected = false;

  constructor() {
    this.isProcessing = false;
    this.initializeStyles();
    this.initializeReplacements();
    this.init();
  }


  initializeStyles() {
    if (ChartEnhancer.stylesInjected) return;

    ChartEnhancer.sheet.replaceSync(`
      .ce-tooltip-container {
        position: relative;
        cursor: help;
        display: inline-block;
        opacity: 1;
        transition-delay: 0.5s;
        border-bottom: 1px dotted black;
      }
	  
	  .ce-tooltip {
		display: none;
		opacity: 0;
		pointer-events: none;
		transition: opacity 0.3s ease, visibility 0s 0.3s;
		
		position: absolute;
		top: 50%;
		right: 100%;
		transform: translateY(-50%);
		margin-right: 10px;
		z-index: 1;

		background-color: #dbd4ad;
		color: #000000;
		font-family: Arial, sans-serif !important;
		padding: 5px;
		border-radius: 3px;
		box-sizing: border-box;

		width: 200px;
		text-align: center;
		
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		align-items: center;
		gap: 4px;
	}
      
      .ce-tooltip-container:hover .ce-tooltip {
        /* Make visible on hover */
        visibility: visible;
        opacity: 1;

        /* Hover-specific styles */
        pointer-events: auto;
        transition-delay: 0s;
        background-color: #dbd4ad;
        background-image: url("https://i.imgur.com/HHIzKoM.png");
        background-size: cover;
        font-family: Arial, sans-serif !important;
        font-style: normal !important;
        box-shadow: 0px 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
      }
	  
	  .ce-tooltip img {
		display: block;
		max-width: 75%;
		height: 50%;
		margin: 0;
      }
    `);
    document.adoptedStyleSheets = [
      ...document.adoptedStyleSheets,
      ChartEnhancer.sheet
    ];

    ChartEnhancer.stylesInjected = true;
  }

  createTooltip(text, { img, title, name, desc }) {
    const imgHtml = img ? `<img src="${img}" alt="${name || text}">` : '';
    const titleHtml = title ? `<strong><u>${title}</u></strong>` : '';
    const nameHtml = name ? `<b>${name}</b>` : '';
    const descHtml = desc ? `${desc}` : '';

    return `<span class="ce-tooltip-container">${text}<span class="ce-tooltip">` +
      `${imgHtml}` +
      `${titleHtml}${nameHtml}${descHtml}` +
      `</span></span>`;
  }

  processChart() {
    if (this.isProcessing) return;

    const element = document.getElementById("overall_result");
    if (!element) return;

    const content = element.innerHTML;

    if (content.includes('class="ce-tooltip"')) {
      return;
    }

    this.isProcessing = true;

    let newContent = content;
    let hasChanges = false;

    for (const [searchText, replacement] of this.replacements) {
      if (newContent.includes(searchText)) {
        newContent = newContent.replace(new RegExp(searchText, 'g'), replacement);
        hasChanges = true;
      }
    }

    if (hasChanges) {
      element.innerHTML = newContent;
    }

    setTimeout(() => {
      this.isProcessing = false;
    }, 100);
  }

  init() {
    const checkAndProcess = () => {
      this.processChart();
    };

    this.intervalId = setInterval(() => {
      requestAnimationFrame(checkAndProcess);
    }, 200);
  }

  destroy() {
    if (this.intervalId) {
      clearInterval(this.intervalId);
    }
  }
}

const chartEnhancer = new ChartEnhancer();

//taken from All the Way, but modified

var changeGameDisp = (hide) => {
  let disp = hide ? "none" : "";

  Array.from(gameWindow.children).forEach(f => {
    if (!f.classList.contains("game_header") && (f.id != "main_content_area" || !$("#campaign_sign")[0]))
      f.style.display = disp;
  });


  const footer = document.getElementById("new_footer");
  if (footer) {
    if (hide) {
      footer.remove();       
    } else {
      gameWindow.appendChild(footer); 
    }
  }
};

// taken from All the Way, but, we won't call LBJ. This is just so that there is something defined at the beginning.

e.vpSwitcher = () => {
  const showCandidateSelection = () => {
    e.candidate_json.forEach(candidate => {
      if (candidate.pk === 152 && (e.noCounter == 4 && EscapeType == "farmer")) { // LBJ
        candidate.fields.description = `
                    <div style="max-height: 200px; overflow-y: auto;">
                        <p><style="font-size: 1.2em;"><strong>The end is in sight now.</strong> Just one more hill to climb.</p><p> President Johnson has walked a long path, the burden is great, his hands are stained, his followers weary. The wilderness calls, a twin-headed wolf ready to devour everything you've built. But you can’t look back now. You’re almost there.</</p>
                    </div>
                `;
        candidate.fields.image_url = "https://i.imgur.com/Nf4aKvB.gif"
      } else if (candidate.pk === 156 && (e.noCounter == 4 && EscapeType == "farmer")) { // HHH
        candidate.fields.description_as_running_mate = `
                    <div style="max-height: 200px; overflow-y: auto;">
                        <p><style="font-size: 1.2em;"><strong> Just look at him.</strong><p> That weepy eyed nancy boy. Is there really a man trapped inside him, or should you be swapping out his suit and tie for a nice little dress. 4 years he’s been here, and what good has he done. The liberals are sick of the sight of him, those kids would rather spit on him than vote for him and he’s too much of a sissy for those southern boys.</p><p> At this point, he’s just dead weight.</p><p>Begging to be cut loose.</p>
                    </div>
                `;
        candidate.fields.image_url = "https://i.imgur.com/OO7Npbo.gif";
      }
    });

    let availableCandidates = e.candidate_json.filter(candidate => {
      return candidate.pk === 152; // Example: Only LBJ is available initially
    });

    // Generate options for available candidates
    let candidateOptions = availableCandidates.map(candidate => `
            <option value="${candidate.pk}">${candidate.fields.first_name} ${candidate.fields.last_name}</option>
        `).join("");

    // Generate the HTML for candidate selection
    let candidateHtml = `
            <div id="candidate_form">
                <form name="candidate">
                    <p></p>
                    <h3>Please select whose perspective you shall control:</h3>
                    <select name="candidate_id" id="candidate_id">
                        ${candidateOptions}
                    </select>
                    <p></p>
                </form>
            </div>
            <div class="person_description_window" id="candidate_description_window">
                <div class="person_image" id="candidate_image"></div>
                <div class="person_summary" id="candidate_summary">
                    <p>Select a candidate to see details.</p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <p>
                <button class="person_button" id="candidate_continue_button">Continue</button>
            </p>
        `;

    // Create the candidate selection screen
    let candidateScreen = document.createElement("div");
    candidateScreen.classList.add("inner_window_w_desc");
    candidateScreen.id = "inner_window_candidate";
    candidateScreen.innerHTML = candidateHtml;

    changeGameDisp(true);

    gameWindow.appendChild(candidateScreen);

    // Automatically select the first candidate and display their details
    const defaultCandidate = availableCandidates[0];
    if (defaultCandidate) {
      $("#candidate_id").val(defaultCandidate.pk); // Set the dropdown to the first option
      $("#candidate_description_window").html(`
                <div class="person_image" id="candidate_image">
                    <img src="${defaultCandidate.fields.image_url}" width="210" height="250">
                </div>
                <div class="person_summary" id="candidate_summary">
                    <ul>
                        <li>Name: ${defaultCandidate.fields.first_name} ${defaultCandidate.fields.last_name}</li>
                        <li>Affiliation: ${defaultCandidate.fields.party}</li>
                        <li>Location of Origin: ${defaultCandidate.fields.state}</li>
                    </ul>
                    ${defaultCandidate.fields.description}
                </div>
            `);
    }

    // Handle candidate selection changes
    $("#candidate_id").change((_e) => {
      _e.preventDefault();

      let selectedCandidateId = Number($("#candidate_id").val());
      let candidate = e.candidate_json.find(c => c.pk === selectedCandidateId);

      if (candidate) {
        $("#candidate_description_window").html(`
                    <div class="person_image" id="candidate_image">
                        <img src="${candidate.fields.image_url}" width="210" height="250">
                    </div>
                    <div class="person_summary" id="candidate_summary">
                        <ul>
                            <li>Name: ${candidate.fields.first_name} ${candidate.fields.last_name}</li>
                            <li>Affiliation: ${candidate.fields.party}</li>
                            <li>Location of Origin: ${candidate.fields.state}</li>
                        </ul>
                        ${candidate.fields.description}
                    </div>
                `);
      }
    });

    // Handle "Continue" button click
    $("#candidate_continue_button").click((_e) => {
      _e.preventDefault();

      let selectedCandidateId = Number($("#candidate_id").val());
      if (!selectedCandidateId) {
        alert("Please select a candidate before proceeding.");
        return;
      }
      e.candidate_id = selectedCandidateId;

      // Remove the candidate screen and proceed to the running mate selection
      $("#inner_window_candidate").remove();
      showRunningMateSelection();
    });
  };

                `,
        "color_hex": "#00DDFF",
        "secondary_color_hex": null,
        "image_url": "https://i.imgur.com/XdBqJjY.gif"
      }
    };


    // Filter existing running mates based on the selected candidate
    let potentialRunningMates = e.running_mate_json
      .filter(f => f.fields.candidate === e.candidate_id)
      .map(f => e.candidate_json.find(_f => _f.pk === f.fields.running_mate));

    // Shuffle the final list of potential running mates using Fisher-Yates
    for (let i = potentialRunningMates.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      [potentialRunningMates[i], potentialRunningMates[j]] = [potentialRunningMates[j], potentialRunningMates[i]];
    }

    // Generate options for running mates
    let runningMateOptions = potentialRunningMates.map(rm => `
            <option value="${rm.pk}">${rm.fields.first_name} ${rm.fields.last_name}</option>
        `).join("");

    // Generate the HTML for running mate selection
    let runningMateHtml = `
            <div id="running_mate_form">
                <form name="running mate">
                    <p></p>
                    <h3>Please select the one that you shall deal with:</h3>
                    <select name="running_mate_id" id="running_mate_id">
                        ${runningMateOptions}
                    </select>
                    <p></p>
                </form>
            </div>
            <div class="person_description_window" id="running_mate_description_window">
                <div class="person_image" id="running_mate_image">
                    <img src="${potentialRunningMates[0].fields.image_url}" width="210" height="250">
                </div>
                <div class="person_summary" id="running_mate_summary">
                    <ul>
                        <li>Name: ${potentialRunningMates[0].fields.first_name} ${potentialRunningMates[0].fields.last_name}</li>
                        <li>Affilation: ${potentialRunningMates[0].fields.party}</li>
                        <li>Location of Origin: ${potentialRunningMates[0].fields.state}</li>
                    </ul>
                    ${potentialRunningMates[0].fields.description_as_running_mate}
                </div>
            </div>
            <p>
                <button class="person_button" id="running_mate_back_button">Back</button>
                <button class="person_button" id="running_mate_confirm_button">Confirm</button>
            </p>
        `;

    // Create the running mate selection screen
    let runningMateScreen = document.createElement("div");
    runningMateScreen.classList.add("inner_window_w_desc");
    runningMateScreen.id = "inner_window_running_mate";
    runningMateScreen.innerHTML = runningMateHtml;

    gameWindow.appendChild(runningMateScreen);

    // Automatically select the first running mate and display their details
    const defaultRunningMate = potentialRunningMates[0];
    if (defaultRunningMate) {
      $("#running_mate_id").val(defaultRunningMate.pk); // Set the dropdown to the first option
      $("#running_mate_description_window").html(`
                <div class="person_image" id="running_mate_image">
                    <img src="${defaultRunningMate.fields.image_url}" width="210" height="250">
                </div>
                <div class="person_summary" id="running_mate_summary">
                    <ul>
                        <li>Name: ${defaultRunningMate.fields.first_name} ${defaultRunningMate.fields.last_name}</li>
                        <li>Affiliation: ${defaultRunningMate.fields.party}</li>
                        <li>Location of Origin: ${defaultRunningMate.fields.state}</li>
                    </ul>
                    ${defaultRunningMate.fields.description_as_running_mate}
                </div>
            `);
    }

    // Handle running mate selection changes
    $("#running_mate_id").change((_e) => {
      _e.preventDefault();

      let selectedRunningMateId = Number($("#running_mate_id").val());
      let runningMate = potentialRunningMates.find(rm => rm.pk === selectedRunningMateId);

      if (runningMate) {
        $("#running_mate_description_window").html(`
                    <div class="person_image" id="running_mate_image">
                        <img src="${runningMate.fields.image_url}" width="210" height="250">
                    </div>
                    <div class="person_summary" id="running_mate_summary">
                        <ul>
                            <li>Name: ${runningMate.fields.first_name} ${runningMate.fields.last_name}</li>
                            <li>Affiliation: ${runningMate.fields.party}</li>
                            <li>Location of Origin: ${runningMate.fields.state}</li>
                        </ul>
                        ${runningMate.fields.description_as_running_mate}
                    </div>
                `);
      }
    });

    // Handle "Back" button click
    $("#running_mate_back_button").click((_e) => {
      _e.preventDefault();

      // Remove the running mate screen and go back to candidate selection
      $("#inner_window_running_mate").remove();
      showCandidateSelection();
    });

    // Handle "Confirm" button click
    $("#running_mate_confirm_button").click((_e) => {
      _e.preventDefault();

      let selectedRunningMateId = Number($("#running_mate_id").val());
      if (!selectedRunningMateId) {
        alert("Please select a running mate before confirming.");
        return;
      }
      e.running_mate_id = selectedRunningMateId;

      // Apply changes based on the selected running mate

      // Restore the game display and remove the running mate screen
      $("#inner_window_running_mate").remove();
      changeGameDisp(false);

      setTimeout(() => {
        $("#view_electoral_map").trigger("click");
      }, 5);
      setTimeout(() => {
        $("#resume_questions_button").trigger("click");
      }, 10);
    });
  };

  // Start with candidate selection
  showCandidateSelection();
};


const updateCandidateProfile = (
  candidatePk,
  firstName,
  lastName,
  imageUrl,
  description,
  home,
  party,
  runningMateDescription,
) => {
  e.candidate_json.forEach(candidate => {
    if (candidate.pk === candidatePk) {
      candidate.fields.first_name = firstName;
      candidate.fields.last_name = lastName;
      candidate.fields.image_url = imageUrl;
      candidate.fields.description = description;
      candidate.fields.state = home;
      candidate.fields.party = party;
      candidate.fields.description_as_running_mate = runningMateDescription;
    }
  });
};

let runningmatefullname = "Alf Richardson";

function affect_issue_score(candidateId, issueId, num, weight) {
  for (let entry of e.candidate_issue_score_json) {
    if (entry.fields.candidate == candidateId && entry.fields.issue == issueId) {
      entry.fields.issue_score = (1 - weight) * entry.fields.issue_score + weight * num;
    }
  }
}

function createNewImageElement(src, border) {
  let newImage = document.createElement('img');
  newImage.src = src;
  newImage.style.height = '14em';
  if (border === 'borderBottom') {
    newImage.style.borderBottom = '2px solid black';
  } else if (border === 'borderTop') {
    newImage.style.borderTop = '2px solid black';
  }
  return newImage;
}

function createBox(imageElement, role, text) {
  let container = document.createElement('div');
  container.classList.add('rounded-box');

  container.style.borderColor = '#1F1D19';
  if (e.altcolors) {
    container.style.backgroundColor = '#c7c7c7';
  }
  else {
    container.style.backgroundColor = '#bdbdbd';
  }
  //container.style.backgroundImage = "url('https://i.imgur.com/timosT8.png')";
  // container.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';  
  // //container.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';  
  // container.style.backgroundRepeat = 'no-repeat';

  let textBox = document.createElement('div');
  let textBox2 = document.createElement('div');
  textBox.style.fontSize = '12px';
  textBox.style.padding = '2px';
  textBox.style.textAlign = 'center';
  textBox.style.marginTop = '-6px';
  textBox.style.marginBottom = '-12px';
  textBox.innerHTML = '<h3 style="color: #000000;">' + role + '</h3>';
  textBox2.style.fontSize = '16px';
  textBox2.style.padding = '2px';
  textBox2.style.textAlign = 'center';
  textBox2.style.marginTop = '-16px';
  textBox2.style.marginBottom = '-12px';
  textBox2.innerHTML = '<h3 style="color: #000000;">' + text + '</h3>';

  container.appendChild(imageElement);
  container.appendChild(textBox);
  container.appendChild(textBox2);

  return container;
}

function createBoxWithTextAndPic(text, pictureSrc) {
  let container = document.createElement('div');
  container.classList.add('rounded-box');

  container.style.borderColor = '#1F1D19';
  if (e.altcolors) {
    container.style.backgroundColor = '#c7c7c7';
  }
  else {
    container.style.backgroundColor = '#bdbdbd';
  }
  //container.style.backgroundImage = "url('https://i.imgur.com/timosT8.png')";
  // container.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';  
  // container.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';  
  // container.style.backgroundRepeat = 'no-repeat';

  let textBox = document.createElement('div');
  textBox.style.fontSize = '16px';
  textBox.style.padding = '3px';
  textBox.style.textAlign = 'center';
  textBox.innerHTML = '<h3 style="color: #000000;">' + text + '</h3>';

  let pictureElement = createNewImageElement(pictureSrc, 'borderTop');

  container.appendChild(textBox);
  container.appendChild(pictureElement);

  return container;
}
async function handleMutations(mutationsList, observer) {
  if (observerRunning) return;
  observerRunning = true;
  observer.disconnect();
  await handleFooter();
  observer.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  observerRunning = false;
}

document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
  if (event.key === 'Enter') {
    // Check the input when Enter is pressed
    checkInput();
  } else if (event.key.length === 1 && inputString.length < 9) {
    // Append the typed key to the input string
    inputString += event.key;
  } else if (event.key.length === 1 && inputString.length === 9) {
    // If the input string has reached 7 characters, reset it
    inputString = event.key;
  }
});

function switch_scores_rodney_opinion_to_fallout_2_opinion() {
  campaignTrail_temp.issues_json[4]["fields"]["name"] = "Fallout 2 Opinion";
  campaignTrail_temp.issues_json[4]["fields"]["description"] = "What does this state think of the hit video game developed by Black Isle Studios and published by Interplay Entertainment?";
  campaignTrail_temp.issues_json[4]["fields"]["stance_1"] = "Worst Game Ever";
  campaignTrail_temp.issues_json[4]["fields"]["stance_desc_1"] = "Not even worthy of being called 'Fallout'.";
  campaignTrail_temp.issues_json[4]["fields"]["stance_2"] = "Very Bad Game";
  campaignTrail_temp.issues_json[4]["fields"]["stance_desc_2"] = "It's not really that fun at all. Don't play it.";
  campaignTrail_temp.issues_json[4]["fields"]["stance_3"] = "Bad Game";
  campaignTrail_temp.issues_json[4]["fields"]["stance_desc_3"] = "Doesn't hold up to today's standards.";
  campaignTrail_temp.issues_json[4]["fields"]["stance_4"] = "Flawed";
  campaignTrail_temp.issues_json[4]["fields"]["stance_desc_4"] = "Kinda buggy";
  campaignTrail_temp.issues_json[4]["fields"]["stance_5"] = "Ok Game";
  campaignTrail_temp.issues_json[4]["fields"]["stance_desc_5"] = "Yeah, it's a game, but, it's dated.";
  campaignTrail_temp.issues_json[4]["fields"]["stance_6"] = "It's Alright";
  campaignTrail_temp.issues_json[4]["fields"]["stance_desc_6"] = "It's a game, alright.";
  campaignTrail_temp.issues_json[4]["fields"]["stance_7"] = "Best Game Ever";
  campaignTrail_temp.issues_json[4]["fields"]["stance_desc_7"] = "It's peak.";
  var id = campaignTrail_temp.candidate_issue_score_json.map(p => p.pk).indexOf(35457);
  campaignTrail_temp.candidate_issue_score_json[id].fields.issue_score = 1;
  var id = campaignTrail_temp.candidate_issue_score_json.map(p => p.pk).indexOf(633);
